headlines.title: Jim Cramer Cheered Marvell’s $12 Billion Google Deal but the Stock Just Fell Nearly 10%
headlines.summary: Jim Cramer celebrated a blockbuster Google deal as proof that Marvell's CEO scores again, but the stock just shed nearly 10% after the earnings call revealed something the headline never mentioned.

headlines.title: Marvell vs. Broadcom: One AI Stock Looks More Attractive Right Now
headlines.summary: Marvell and Broadcom both rode the AI wave to blowout quarters, but the businesses behind the tickers are built on completely different gambles, and only one of them offers a cushion if a major hyperscaler changes course.

headlines.title: Marvell Beat and Raised Guidance. Why Its Google Deal Still Spooked Investors
headlines.summary: A clean beat-and-raise, record data center strength, and a newly expanded Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Google partnership should have helped Marvell Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) win a major boost from Wall Street. Yet, shares fell more than 8% anyway.

headlines.title: Why Is Marvell Technology (MRVL) Pushing Deeper Into AI Photonics?
headlines.summary: Marvell Technology (NasdaqGS: MRVL) plans to acquire Celestial AI, signaling a push into AI-focused photonics and optical connectivity. The deal centers on Celestial AI's photonics technology, which targets growing demand for high-speed data links in AI data centers. Marvell positions the acquisition as a step toward next generation optical transceivers for hyperscale AI workloads and connectivity.

headlines.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Could Be 25% Below Fair Value After Raised Revenue Outlook
headlines.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) reset expectations with a raised multi year revenue outlook and fresh quarterly guidance, after reporting second quarter results that highlighted the scale of its data center and AI exposure. The guidance reset comes after a sharp pullback in Marvell Technology’s shares, with the stock down 12.48% over the past week and 30.25% over the past 90 days. This comes even though the 1 year total shareholder return of 226.38% and 3 year total shareholder return of 266.

description: Marvell Technology, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides data infrastructure semiconductor solutions and spanning the data center core to network edge in the United States, Argentina, China, India, Israel, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, and internationally. The company develops and scales system-on-a-chip architectures, integrating analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing functionality. It offers a portfolio of ethernet solutions, including spanning controllers, network adapters, physical transceivers, and switches; single or multiple core processors; and custom application specific integrated circuits, interconnects, fibre channel adapters, and processors. The company also provides interconnect products, including pulse amplitude modulation, coherent and coherent-lite digital signal processors (DSPs), laser drivers, trans-impedance amplifiers, silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, linear pluggable optics chipsets, data center interconnect, active electrical cable DSPs and peripheral component interconnect express retimer solutions; fibre channel products comprising host bus adapters and controllers for server and storage system connectivity; storage controllers for hard disk drives and solid-state-drives; host system interfaces, including serial advanced technology attachment and serial attached SCSI, peripheral component interconnect express, compute express link switches, non-volatile memory express (NVMe), and NVMe over fabrics; and develops ultra accelerator linkTM switches and ethernet for scale-up networking switches. The company serves data centers, communications, and other markets. It offers its products through direct customers and distributors. Marvell Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware.
